import json, re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts")
dirs=sorted([p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir()], key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
# today's dirs by mtime
import datetime
day=datetime.date(2026,10,24)
todays=[]
for d in root.iterdir():
    if not d.is_dir(): continue
    m=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(d.stat().st_mtime).date()
    if m==day:
        todays.append(d)
    # also check jsonl inside
    for jl in d.glob("*.jsonl"):
        m2=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(jl.stat().st_mtime).date()
        if m2==day:
            todays.append(d)
            break
todays=list({p.resolve():p for p in todays}.values())
print("today dirs", len(todays))
for d in sorted(todays, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime):
    jls=list(d.glob("*.jsonl"))
    print(d.name, "jl", [(j.name, j.stat().st_size) for j in jls])
    for jl in jls:
        users=[]
        last_a=""
        for line in jl.open(errors='ignore'):
            try: o=json.loads(line)
            except: continue
            msg=o.get("message") or o
            role=msg.get("role") or o.get("role") or ""
            content=msg.get("content")
            text=""
            if isinstance(content,str): text=content
            elif isinstance(content,list):
                parts=[]
                for c in content:
                    if isinstance(c,dict):
                        parts.append(c.get("text") or c.get("content") or "")
                    elif isinstance(c,str): parts.append(c)
                text="\n".join(parts)
            if not text: continue
            if role=="user" or "<user_query>" in text:
                m=re.search(r"<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>", text, re.S)
                u=(m.group(1) if m else text).strip()
                # skip system wakes that are just daily report if many
                users.append(u[:350].replace("\n"," "))
            if role=="assistant":
                # skip tool-only
                if len(text)>100 and "<tool" not in text[:20]:
                    last_a=text
        print("  users:")
        for u in users[:10]:
            print("   -", u[:240])
        if last_a:
            # last 600 chars of last substantive assistant
            print("  lastA:", last_a.replace("\n"," ")[-700:])
        print()
PY
